item.title: Bethel girls bounce back with two regional victories
item.description: JONES – After suffering a first-round regional loss to Jones, the Bethel Lady Wildcats bounced back in huge way to secure two victories over Perry 45-34 on Friday and Oklahoma Christian School 33-31 on Saturday to advance to the Class 3A Area Tournament. Bethel 45, Perry 34 (Friday) The two teams battled to a 28-all deadlock through three quarters before the Lady Wildcats closed the game with a 17-6 fourth period to take the win.

item.title: Leedey knocks off Asher in first round of state tournament
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY - For the first time since 1995, Asher made the State Tournament. However, the Class B-II No. 5 Indians’ season came to an end sooner than they hoped as the No. 10 Leedey Bison kept them off balance all night.

item.title: Shawnee wrestler Stetson Tucker takes second place at state
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY – Shawnee High School had one state runner-up placer on the boys’ side and a third-place and a fourth-place finisher on the girls’ side to highlight efforts in the Class 5A State Wrestling Championships last Saturday at the new Fairgrounds Coliseum. In the boys’ division, Tucker Stetson had a second-place finish after going 3-1 in the event at 132 pounds.

item.title: The new face of Shawnee rock: Teenage powerhouse The Shawp re
item.description: SHAWNEE – The Shawp is returning to the historic Ritz Theater stage this Saturday, March 7, to prove they aren’t just a flash in the pan. The teenage blues outfit is set to headline their second appearance at the iconic venue, bringing a matured sound, new songs, and a rapidly growing fanbase with them.
